topic: Reporting a Stolen Bike at the Campus Police Desk

script.title: A STOLEN BICYCLE
script.scene_zh: 校園警衛台 · 報失竊
script.story_hook: A cable, a cut lock, and a paper trail.
script.intro_zh: 一條纜線、一把斷鎖，還有一整份報案紀錄。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the campus police desk today. Listen for reporting a theft.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的校園警衛台。留意失竊報案的說法。
script.outro: The bike is filed, the plan is set. Listen once more and speak along.
script.outro_zh: 報案建檔完成，對策也有了。再聽一遍，跟著開口。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat after us, one line at a time.
script.title_quote: ghost bikes are a campus thing
script.char_a_description: a male college student in his early twenties with curly black hair under a teal beanie, a faded maroon campus hoodie, ripped jeans, a canvas shoulder bag, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a female campus officer in her forties with dark hair in a tight regulation bun, a tan uniform polo, a badge belt, small reading glasses, and a broad strong build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I need to report a stolen bike.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi aɪ nid tə rɪˈpɔɹt ə stoʊl baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我要報案，我的腳踏車失竊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, have a seat. When did it happen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi hæv ə sit wɛn dɪd ɪt ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，先請坐。什麼時候發生的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night, around ten, library side.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt əˈɹaʊnd tɛn ˈlaɪˌbɹɛɹi saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚大約十點，在圖書館那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back rack by the bike cages?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ɹæk baɪ ðə baɪk ˈkeɪdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 是後方停車籠那一區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the third cage, mine was on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə θɜɹd ˈkeɪdʒ maɪn wʌz ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 對，第三個籠，我的車靠在左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any cameras you noticed up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈkæmɹəz ju ˈnoʊtɪst ʌp ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您有沒有注意到那裡有攝影機？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, but they face the road, not the cages.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bʌt ðeɪ feɪs ðə ɹoʊd nɑt ðə ˈkeɪdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 有兩台，但它們對著馬路，不對著停車籠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, so describe the bike for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt soʊ dɪˈskɹaɪb ðə baɪk fɜɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，那描述一下你的車給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's a blue hybrid, medium frame, twenty-one speeds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə blu ˈhaɪˌbɹɪd ˈmidiəm fɹeɪm ˈtwɛnti wʌn spidz/
dialogue.zh: 是一台藍色混合車，中尺寸車架，二十一速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, any stickers, scratches, or repairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈɛni ˈstɪkɚz ˈskɹætʃɪz ɔɹ rɪˈpɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 好，有沒有貼紙、刮痕或修補過的痕跡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sunset sticker on the frame, taped handlebar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsʌnˌsɛt ˈstɪkɚ ɑn ðə fɹeɪm teɪpt ˈhændəlˌbɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 車架有日落圖案貼紙，把手纏著膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape there, noted. What lock did you use?
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ðɛɹ ˈnoʊtəd wʌt lɑk dɪd ju ˈjuːz/
dialogue.zh: 都記錄了。你用的是哪一種鎖？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cable lock, thin one, looped through the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkeɪbəl lɑk θɪn wʌn lupt θɹu ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 一條纜線鎖，很細，繞在輪圈上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin cables fall to bolt cutters in seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ˈkeɪbəlz fɔl tə boʊlt ˈkʌtəɹz ɪn ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 細纜線碰上剪鉗，幾秒就斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, I found the cable in pieces on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈkeɪbəl ɪn ˈpisəz ɑn ðə ɡɹaʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我在地上找到了剪碎的纜線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the usual play, sadly, around ten p.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈjuːʒuəl pleɪ ˈsædli əˈɹaʊnd tɛn ˌpiˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾，這是最常見的手法，多在晚上十點前後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took photos, the cut cable's in them.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk ˈfoʊtoʊz ðə kʌt ˈkeɪbəlzɪn ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我有拍照，剪斷的纜線都在照片裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, upload them to this report portal later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ʌpˈloʊd ðəm tə ðɪs rɪˈpɔɹt ˈpɔɹtəl ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，之後把照片上傳到報案系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure thing, my phone has the whole scene.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ maɪ foʊn hæz ðə hoʊl sin/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我手機裡有現場照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, serial number, do you know yours by heart?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈsɪɹiəl ˈnʌmbɚ du ju noʊ jɔɹz baɪ hɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 接下來是車架序號，這個你背得出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, no, it's under the pedals, I never looked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm noʊ ɪts ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈpɛdəlz aɪ ˈnɛvɚ lʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，沒有，序號在踏板下方，我從來沒低頭看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipt, warranty email, anything with the number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹiˈsɪt ˈwɔɹənti ˈimeɪl ˈɛnɪθɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那收據、保固信，有沒有任何寫到序號的文件？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warranty email, it listed the frame code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔɹənti ˈimeɪl ɪt ˈlɪstɪd ðə fɹeɪm koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 保固信件裡有列出車架碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Search your inbox for serial, then send it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜɹtʃ jɔɹ ˈɪnˌbɑks fɜɹ ˈsɪɹiəl ðɛn sɛnd ɪt ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 搜尋信箱裡的序號關鍵字，然後傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, eight letters, two zeros, sent.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt eɪt ˈlɛtəɹz tu ˈzɪɹoʊz sɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，八個字母加兩個零，已經傳出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked in, your bike is now in the system.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt ɪn jɔɹ baɪk ɪz naʊ ɪn ðə ˈsɪstəm/
dialogue.zh: 建檔完成，這台車已經進系統了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does insurance matter here? I paid renter's, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪnˈʃʊɹəns ˈmæɾɚ hɪɹ aɪ ˈpeɪd ɹɛntəɹz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 保險有用嗎？我記得有買租客保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a policy copy, claims need our report.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ə ˈpɑləsi ˈkɑpi kleɪmz nid ɑʊɹ rɪˈpɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 帶保單影本過來，申請理賠需要報案紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They'll want the report number first, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪl wɑnt ðə rɪˈpɔɹt ˈnʌmbɚ fɜɹst raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他們會先要求報案編號，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and a photo of that empty cage too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzɛktli ænd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ðæt ˈɛmpti ˈkeɪdʒ tu/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，再附一張空停車籠的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels weird, talking about a ghost bike.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs filz wɪɹd ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ə ɡoʊst baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對著表格談一台消失的車，感覺好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ghost bikes are a campus thing, sadly common.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊst baɪkz ɑɹ ə ˈkæmpəs θɪŋ ˈsædli ˈkɑmən/
dialogue.zh: 消失的腳踏車在校園很常聽到，真的不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many reports like mine come in weekly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni rɪˈpɔɹts laɪk maɪn kʌm ɪn ˈwikli/
dialogue.zh: 像我這樣的車失竊案，一週有幾件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten or twelve, mostly cables, mostly after dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɔɹ twɛlv ˈmoʊstli ˈkeɪbəlz ˈmoʊstli ˈæftɚ dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 十件到十二件，多半是纜線鎖，多半在天黑後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, now I feel hopeful, thanks a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt naʊ aɪ fil ˈhoʊpfəl θæŋks ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 真好，我現在充滿希望，真是感謝喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, keep it real, here's the useful part.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kip ɪt ɹiəl hɪɹz ðə ˈjusfəl pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，坦白講，重頭戲是接下來的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Useful like what? I have a lecture soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjusfəl laɪk wʌt aɪ hæv ə ˈlɛktʃɚ sun/
dialogue.zh: 比如什麼建議？我馬上要上課了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch resale sites, stolen bikes get relisted fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ɹiˈseɪl saɪts stoʊl baɪkz ɡɛt ɹiˈlɪstɪd fæst/
dialogue.zh: 盯緊二手拍賣網，失竊車很快就會重新上架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the campus marketplace too? People flip there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈkæmpəs ˈmɑɹkəˌtɛs tu pipəl flɪp ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 校園二手市集也要看嗎？那裡很多人在轉手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially there, set alerts for blue hybrids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈspɛʃəli ðɛɹ sɛt əˈɜɹts fɜɹ blu ˈhaɪˌbɹɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 尤其那裡，把藍色混合車設成上架提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alert words: sunset sticker, taped bar, twenty-one.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɜɹts wɜɹdz ˈsʌnˌsɛt ˈstɪkɚ teɪpt bɑɹ ˈtwɛnti wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 提醒詞就設：日落貼紙、纏膠帶的把手、二十一速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if a bike looks like yours, don't grab it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ə baɪk lʊks laɪk jɔɹz doʊnt ɡɹæb ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 如果看到像你的車，先別自己去取車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd message you, then you handle the meet-up?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈmɛsɪdʒ ju ðɛn ju ˈhændəl ðə mit ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那我先傳訊息給您，後續由你們接手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, snap screenshots, never meet sellers alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzɛktli snæp ˈskɹinˌʃɑts ˈnɛvɚ miːt ˈsɛləɹz əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，先截好圖，絕對不要一個人去見賣家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, here's my email for any updates.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil hɪɹz maɪ ˈimeɪl fɜɹ ˈɛni ˈʌpˌdeɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好，有任何消息請寫信給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Report number ends nine-two-five, check your inbox.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈpɔɹt ˈnʌmbɚ ɛndz naɪn tu faɪv tʃɛk jɔɹ ˈɪnˌbɑks/
dialogue.zh: 報案編號尾碼是九二五，收件匣看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, what if I just want closure?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wʌt ɪf aɪ dʒʌst wɑnt ˈkloʊʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，如果我想要有個明確交代呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bikes surface at lost and found sometimes, two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪkz ˈsɜɹfəs æt lɔst ænd faʊnd ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz tu wiːks/
dialogue.zh: 失竊車偶爾會出現在遺失物中心，約兩週內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks of ghost bike watching, fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks ʌv ɡoʊst baɪk ˈwɑtʃɪŋ fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 要當兩週尋車偵探，真有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check resale sites, fresh listings daily, same routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ɹiˈseɪl saɪts fɹɛʃ ˈlɪstɪŋz ˈdeɪli seɪm ɹuˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 每天刷新二手網站，就是固定的功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the department lend a bike meanwhile?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə dɪˈpɑɹtmənt lɛnd ə baɪk ˈmilˌwaɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 這段期間，你們會出借腳踏車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We run a bike loan program, five days free.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɹʌn ə baɪk lon ˈpɹɑɡɹæm faɪv deɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 我們有借車計畫，可以免費用五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way, that's actually beautiful policy.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ˈbjutəfəl ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？這政策太貼心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill one form, grab a loaner, keep riding.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl wʌn fɔɹm ɡɹæb ə ˈloʊnɚ kip ˈɹaɪdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 填一張表，就能領一台備用車繼續騎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Officer, you just rescued my whole semester.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈfɪsəɹ ju dʒʌst rɪˈskjud maɪ hoʊl səˈmɛstəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 警官，您剛救了我整個學期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bikes are legs here, we know that well.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪkz ɑɹ lɛɡz hɪɹ wi noʊ ðæt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，腳踏車就是腿，我們很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll upload photos tonight, and tell my roommate.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ʌpˈloʊd ˈfoʊtoʊz təˈnaɪt ænd tɛl maɪ ˈɹumˌmeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚會上傳照片，也告訴我室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roommate's a bike owner? More alerts, more eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹumˌmeɪts ə baɪk ˈoʊnəɹ mɔɹ əˈɜɹts mɔɹ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 室友也有車嗎？多一個人留意，多一雙眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson learned: thick chain lock from now on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən lɜrnd θɪk tʃeɪn lɑk fɹʌm naʊ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 學到教訓了：以後改用粗鏈條鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride safe, and ping the portal, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪd seɪf ænd pɪŋ ðə ˈpɔɹtəl dil/
dialogue.zh: 騎車小心，有線索就上系統，好嗎？

script.youtube_title: 【校園腳踏車失竊🚲】「消失的腳踏車是校園日常」教你報案、記序號、盯二手網📱🎧｜聽完就會報案｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Reporting a Stolen Bike
script.youtube_title_en: Ghost Bikes Are a Campus Thing — Reporting a Stolen Bike at the Police Desk
script.youtube_description:
「消失的腳踏車是校園日常」——當纜線鎖變成地上碎片，怎麼走進警衛台把失竊案報得完整又清楚？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在學期中的校園警察服務台。

你會聽到：說明案發時間地點、描述車架貼紙與刮痕、交代鎖的種類；搜尋保固信裡的序號、上傳照片到報案系統、申請保險理賠；還有按警官建議盯二手拍賣網、設定上架提醒、申請備用借車計畫的實用對話。

全篇使用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿真實報案的語感：um、yeah、ha、right?、exactly。聽完你就會用：I need to report、do you know yours by heart、Bring a policy copy、set alerts for。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著念，先把舌頭練熟，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Ghost bikes are a campus thing" — when your cable lock ends up in pieces on the pavement, how do you file a clean theft report? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at the campus police desk.

You will hear: giving the time and place, describing stickers and scratches on the frame, naming your lock; hunting the serial number in a warranty email, uploading photos to the portal, and preparing insurance papers; plus tips on resale-site alerts and a free loaner-bike program.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real reporting rhythm: um, yeah, ha, right?, exactly. By the end you'll own lines like I need to report a stolen bike, Do you know yours by heart, and set alerts for blue hybrids.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.
